instruction: Mark all emails in the local Bills folder as read

rules.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE folderID = 13) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messageAttributes WHERE attributeID = 59 AND value = 1 AND messageID IN (SELECT id FROM messages WHERE folderID = 13)) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE folderID = 13) > 0;

metadata.explanation: Task requires marking all emails in the Bills folder (folderID=13) as read. The evaluator checks if the 'read' attribute (attributeID=59) is set to 1 (true) for messages in the Bills folder. Verified from database: Bills folder has 2 emails, attributeID 59 corresponds to 'read' status.

llm_judge_reasons: SQL query correctly verifies ALL emails in Bills folder are marked as read by comparing total email count with read email count
Query structure: (total_emails == read_emails) AND (total_emails > 0) ensures complete coverage and non-empty folder
Getter (get_vm_file) correctly extracts the Thunderbird SQLite database after closing Thunderbird (postconfig)
Metric (run_sqlite3) executes the SQL and returns 1.0 if the equality holds, 0.0 otherwise - semantically correct for boolean verification
Expected value structure with type='rule' is handled correctly - framework calls get_rule which returns the rules dict directly to run_sqlite3

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric run_sqlite3 first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
